content.text: {"quote_faithful":"yes","verdict":"confirmed","evidence_kind":"invalid_inference","fatal":"yes","explanation":"The quoted induction is the write-up’s only justification of Lemma (ii), and its preservation step is not established. After the first j+1 original columns there are 1+2+⋯+2^j=2^(j+1)−1 d-strips; two copies plus one would contain 2^(j+2)−1 strips, not the 2^(j+1) strips in the next column. More importantly, cuts may occur at arbitrary heights, so the resulting pieces need not decompose into whole d-strips. The text gives no invariant or argument showing that cancellation must leave a whole odd d-strip unless every original column was cut. Thus the asserted dichotomy, and hence Δ≥d, does not follow. Since Section 3 relies solely on Lemma (ii), the lower-bound obligation remains unproved as written."}
